entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I got so nervous I almost stuttered a few[n]times... I thought I was used to police[n]questioning by now too...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems we were all asked the same[n]questions.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's how they get you. They do that on[n]purpose, then wait for someone to slip up.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I hope you didn't.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...It was prolly fine. I woulda been done[n]for if they saw how sweaty my hands[n]were, though.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think my name would come up[n]as well...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sounds like we can't take the police[n]lightly either.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, didn't you think that detective guy[n]was scary?
Yeah, he was.
Seemed normal to me.
I don't remember.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Especially those eyes... It was like they[n]were smiling, but not...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Not to me... He looked like someone[n]who's dealt with dangerous criminals.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No way. I feel like he's gonna show up in[n]my nightmares. That emotionless voice...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sorry for all of this... It's because of[n]my sister...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's not true, Mako-chan.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's not as though I hadn't predicted this[n]would happen...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But now that it's become reality,[n]I'm unsure of what to do...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We need to make sure we don't draw[n]suspicion, and work to clear our names...[n]right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It ain't your fault, Makoto.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm gonna try to see how far along this[n]investigation really is.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm worried about the police too, but[n]as of now, anyone in this city could be[n]a mole...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We were so popular too...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Haru, can I ask you to search your[n]father's belongings for clues about[n]a possible culprit?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... I know it may be tough on you...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: No, it's okay. Now isn't the time for me[n]to look away.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: As for everyone else, you need to be[n]cautious of how you spend your time[n]at school.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, I've decided to have you three[n]second-years join me on the school[n]festival executive committee.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It will allow us to gather without drawing[n]suspicion. Plus, trying to blend in will[n]only do the opposite.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh... Fine.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I agree. The more time I have to kill,[n]the more time I'll spend worrying about[n]all this stuff.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No matter what happens... I don't want to[n]regret my decisions.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't jinx it!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It would be no surprise if they came[n]directly to our homes for questioning.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: They showed up at your school, after all...[n]I should remain cautious.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: For now, the best option is to stay on the[n]defensive... but we won't make progress[n]at this rate.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's try and figure out who the real[n]culprit is somehow, okay?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Of course...
